Reverse Proxy Explained: The Server in Front of Your App

Quick thread 🧵
A reverse proxy is a server that sits in front of your application, takes every incoming client request, and forwards it to the app behind it, then passes the response back.
It handles TLS, routing, and static files, and hides your backend so clients only ever talk to one public address.
